environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2 with Python 3.9, gunicorn workers=4. Database is local SQLite on ephemeral storage. CloudWatch basic monitoring enabled but no custom metrics on query patterns.
